placements.why: Directives commanding the systematic removal and forgetting of past architectural migrations and decisions establish an organizational stratum for context lifecycle and knowledge governance.
placements.title: Institutional Memory Lifecycle and Context Governance
placements.frame: How does the organization establish, maintain, and prune its operational memory and historical decision records?

placements.title: Deliberate Excision of Superseded Technical and Decision History
placements.frame: When and how are obsolete technical migrations and abandoned decisions systematically purged from working context?
placements.why: Both expressions function as explicit instructions to expunge historical milestones (the Quantum Widget Decision and the PostgreSQL to QuantumDB migration) to prevent legacy context from persisting.
